checks.evidence: verify defaults: 8 checks, no FAIL. loop_seam PASS (wrap discontinuity 0.12x the 99th-percentile step, spectral change 2.5 dB; limits 2 and 6). Also finite, peak -1.00 dBFS, dc -78 dB, rebuild bit-identical, and all three macro claims pass.

time_shape.evidence: Loop, 5.000 s, no silent edges. 57 onsets in 5 s (about 11 a second) at seed 1, well over 5 a second; the first 16 gaps are roughly 30-170 ms. Seeds 2-4 give 59 / 49 / 46 onsets (9-12 a second). LUFS curve is flat at -20 to -23 over the whole loop; there is no decay, as a loop should have.

spectrum.evidence: Roar under 300 Hz: bands 63 / 125 / 250 Hz are -24.9 / -24.1 / -28.0 dB overall, the loudest by 4 dB or more, with 500 Hz-1 kHz a trough at -40 to -43 dB. Hiss: 4 kHz and 8k+ sit at -31 and -30 dB in every segment, and the spectrogram shows a broadband haze above 4 kHz. Centroid is 1.12k / 2.08k / 1.10k Hz (start / middle / end), pulled up by hiss and crackle. Not quite stable: the roar is about 5 dB louder at the loop ends than in the middle (63 Hz: -23.2 to -28.7 to -23.2), a slow once-per-loop swell.

parts.evidence: All three parts show separately. Crackles: vertical broadband streaks reaching 16 kHz in the spectrogram, and spiky peaks on the waveform with crest 17.5 dB. Roar: a continuous orange band below 250 Hz, with a 305 Hz rolloff at the start. Hiss: the continuous 4-16 kHz haze between the streaks. The three knobs isolate them: hiss=0 drops 8k+ from -30 to -33 dB and the centroid from 1.12k to 554 Hz, weight=1 gives a 387 Hz centroid, and snap=0 leaves 49 onsets at lower strength.

control_variation.evidence: 3 macros (weight, hiss, snap), all claims PASS. weight centroid 3.3k -> 463 Hz; hiss 681 Hz -> 6.9k; snap crest 15.3 -> 19.7 dB. The 4 seeds differ: onsets 57 / 59 / 49 / 46, peak times 0.69 / 1.08 / 1.44 / 0.49 s, centroid at start 1.12k / 1.32k / 1.55k / 1.77k. All keep a low roar, a hiss and more than 5 crackles a second.

notes: The hiss macro at 1.0 buries the crackles: only 13 onsets (about 2.6 a second), centroid 6.3k. The top of that knob leaves the brief, and only the 0..0.5 part keeps 5+ a second.

DC varies by seed: -78 dB (seed 1), -43 / -61 / -46 dB (seeds 2-4). The seed 2 value is close to the -40 dB check limit, and the default verify only runs seed 1. Seed 2 also shows a 44 Hz mode at -16 dB.

Roar and hiss have a once-per-loop swell because of the crossfade against their reverse (palindromic loop): the roar is louder at the loop ends than in the middle, and the hiss and crackle band is brighter in the middle (centroid 2.08k vs 1.1k). Seed 1 rolloff swings from 305 Hz to 4.5 kHz between start and middle.
